scope: Physical defense only; existing operative class baseline once, +1 Vitality per level after level 1 with current class conversion, five +0 armor pieces. No weapons/shield, cloak, passives, active buffs, affixes, upgrades, gems or invented starting attributes.

rankLevelMapping.status: User-defined evaluation checkpoints, not enforced armor level requirements

anchor.rule: Per-class divisor = total physical defense at 40 / 40

limitations: R1 at level 1 is an allowed starter exception; computed targets there are diagnostic only.
Target armor sums are hypothetical nearest-integer corrections, not applied and not approval of gameplay balance.
Skills and buffs require separate progression checks.
